usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.beta.assistants.update("assistant_id", model="string", reasoning_effort="none", name="string", description="string", instructions="string", tools=[{"type": "code_interpreter"}], tool_resources={"code_interpreter": {"file_ids": ["string"]}, "file_search": {"vector_store_ids": ["string"]}}, metadata={"key": "string"}, temperature=1, top_p=1, response_format="auto")
print(result)
